'''040756''' was an accident report concerning incidents at the [[Morjanssik Mine]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Morjanssik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. The accident report was referenced against several others concerning a series of suspicious incidents that were ultimately found out to be the work of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteurs]].
